mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum fxUSD ordinarily mints through collateralized CDP pools, but the PoolManager administrator can register an arbitrary mint-critical pool module and raise its debt capacity without an independent collateral predicate. The current three-day timelock, rooted in the reviewed 6-of-9 Safe, can therefore authorize a durable unbacked mint path without upgrading code. Native economic issuance is unbounded and unreconciled; Base LayerZero controls remain scoped to Bridge Risk.

controls.label: fxUSD native ProxyAdmin (Ethereum token and PoolManager)
bypassSurfaces: Both the Ethereum fxUSD proxy and PoolManager proxy are administered by ProxyAdmin 0x9b54..., whose owner is TimelockController 0x6886... with a 259,200-second delay; the governed 6-of-9 Safe can replace mint-critical logic.

At Ethereum block 25770536, the PoolManager proxy 0x250893ca4ba5d05626c785e8da758026928fcd24 returned implementation 0xa70dddb8ddd06b1c26061d998e041748b18ecf85 and the same ProxyAdmin. ProxyAdmin owner() is TimelockController 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a with getMinDelay() = 259200 seconds.

controls.label: fxUSD token proxy (EIP-1967, OZ TransparentUpgradeableProxy)
controls.capDescription: The token accepts mint calls only from its immutable PoolManager. Existing wstETH/WBTC pools check collateral, but the PoolManager administrator can register an arbitrary pool module and expand its debt capacity; the token has no independent collateral predicate on that module-authorized mint path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770715, EIP-1967 slots confirmed: implementation = 0xf729422d68c2cf00574fb5712972454cf402a9b1 and proxy admin = 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4 (OZ ProxyAdmin).

controls.label: f(x) Protocol OZ TimelockController (3-day delay)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770536, ProxyAdmin owner() and PoolManager DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE checks identify TimelockController 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a; getMinDelay() returns 259200 seconds. The Timelock can register pools and update pool capacities. The 6-of-9 Safe 0x26B2ec4E02ebe2F54583af25b647b1D619e67BbF passes PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE checks; complete current TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE history was not recovered from the public RPC. D14/A7 corrective review on 2026-10-03 at ethereum block 26113622 (0x5f41a07faa7b201ebd6180fd900a8e50989c7d3ac2f09c64d5b5d6272ad71cb9): token and PoolManager implementations remain 0xf729422d68c2cf00574fb5712972454cf402a9b1 and 0xa70dddb8ddd06b1c26061d998e041748b18ecf85. PoolManager.hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a) is true. Verified registerPool accepts an arbitrary module address and capacities without code, collateral, or health validation; a pinned eth_call from that timelock registering a no-code address with positive capacities succeeds. operate delegates position validation to the registered pool, then accepts its returned newRawDebt and calls _handleBorrow, which invokes fxUSD.mint for the caller. A newly authorized module can return positive debt with zero collateral movement. This is mint-module authorization, not merely collateral/oracle admission and not an upgrade-only inference. The timelock's 259200-second minimum and the Safe's proposer/executor/canceller roles were re-read. Economic cap semantics are unbounded; the derived fallback is unbounded-adverse. Reconciliation remains not-applicable and supervision none. Safe-rooted authority and incomplete executionScopes cannot qualify for D29.

controls.label: f(x) Protocol governance multisig (6-of-9 Gnosis Safe)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796, Safe reads returned threshold 6, nine owners, and no enabled modules for governance Safe 0x26B2ec4E02ebe2F54583af25b647b1D619e67BbF. The owner list includes 0x18411aB626c9b3B3Dd5b7356574D8ff396436744 in place of the previously recorded 0x4088421cBDBa1501d8Fd09fD241717097Afb42Cb. The Safe passes the Timelock PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE checks at the same block. Guard state was not resolved in this observation and remains unknown.

review.evidence: Ethereum fxUSD issuance is the sole reviewed native path. The fxUSD ERC-20 and PoolManager proxies are administered by ProxyAdmin 0x9b54...; ProxyAdmin owner() is TimelockController 0x6886... with a 259,200-second delay, and the 6-of-9 Safe 0x26B2... is the verified proposer/executor/canceller authority. FxUSD minting is restricted to the PoolManager's registered, collateral-gated CDP flow; the reviewed wstETH and WBTC pools have configured debt capacities and operate through collateral and price checks. The native posture remains partially-bounded-admin with raiseable economic cap semantics, not-applicable reconciliation for the on-chain collateral-gated path, and no identified prudential supervisor. The Base OFT peer and LayerZero messaging authority is reviewed under Bridge Risk only and is not part of the global Mint Authority assessment. D14/A7 corrective review on 2026-10-03 at ethereum block 26113622 (0x5f41a07faa7b201ebd6180fd900a8e50989c7d3ac2f09c64d5b5d6272ad71cb9): token and PoolManager implementations remain 0xf729422d68c2cf00574fb5712972454cf402a9b1 and 0xa70dddb8ddd06b1c26061d998e041748b18ecf85. A newly authorized module can return positive debt with zero collateral movement. This is mint-module authorization, not merely collateral/oracle admission and not an upgrade-only inference. The timelock's 259200-second minimum and the Safe's proposer/executor/canceller roles were re-read. Economic cap semantics are unbounded; the derived fallback is unbounded-adverse.
